benefits.name: Annual Morgan Stanley Statement Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 statement credit each calendar year after spending $15,000 on eligible purchases — a benefit exclusive to Morgan Stanley cardholders.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible purchases per calendar year to trigger the credit. Exclusive to the Morgan Stanley version of the card.

benefits.name: Disney Streaming Credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 back each month in statement credits after spending on an eligible Disney+, Hulu, or ESPN subscription with the enrolled card.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Credits do not carry over month to month. Totals up to $120 per year if used every month. This credit was increased from a previous $7/month Disney Bundle credit — confirm the current amount before relying on it.

benefits.name: Equinox+ Credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 in statement credits per month, up to $120 per calendar year, on an Equinox+ subscription.
benefits.terms: Enrollment required. Credits do not carry over month to month. Totals up to $120 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement for eligible items in working condition that the merchant will not accept for return within 90 days of purchase, up to $300 per item and $1,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against theft or accidental damage for 90 days from the purchase date, up to $1,000 per occurrence and $50,000 per card member account per calendar year.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Adds up to one additional year to eligible original manufacturer warranties of five years or less, up to $10,000 per item and $50,000 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage up to $50,000 per rental for collision damage or theft of most rental vehicles.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage. Must pay for the entire rental with the card and decline the rental company's collision damage waiver. Does not include liability coverage.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency referral and coordination service for medical, legal, financial, and travel emergencies when traveling more than 100 miles from home.
benefits.terms: Referral and coordination only — third-party costs incurred are the cardholder's responsibility.

benefits.name: Amex Presale Tickets
benefits.description: Access to presale and cardmember-only ticket offers for concerts, theater, and sporting events.

earningRates.terms: 6% cash back at U.S. supermarkets on up to $6,000 per year in purchases, then 1%.
6% cash back on select U.S. streaming subscriptions. No annual spend cap on this category.
3% cash back at U.S. gas stations.
3% cash back on transit, including taxis, rideshare, parking, tolls, trains, and buses.
1% cash back on all other eligible purchases, and at U.S. supermarkets after the $6,000 annual cap. Cash back is received as Reward Dollars redeemable as a statement credit or at Amazon.com checkout.
